correctness.rationale: A complete exact-rational coefficient verification in seven independent harmonic coordinates proves two universal integral identities, testing every degree-four monomial coefficient (210 slots). The Gram matrix B is symmetric with trace E>0, so tr(B²)=E²/3+||B-EI/3||_F²; this gives the displayed remainder and iff equality, attained by xyz. All normalizations and boundary conditions were checked from actual packaged code.

value.rationale: A natural globally sharp lower L4/L2 constant for every real cubic spherical harmonic on S2, with an exact nonnegative isotropy-defect remainder and an intrinsic necessary/sufficient equality condition, complements classical L4 upper/local-max problems. The degree-three harmonic space exhibits genuine moment variation unlike the real degree-two case, so this is not a routine single-example evaluation.
